integrity: The proof derives the complete commuting relation from invertibility, determines every multipartite class, proves the Lie-algebra isomorphism criterion directly, and computes graph automorphisms from the part-size multiset. A standalone checker verifies direct pairwise brackets for several fields, dimensions, and inequivalent actions.
scientific_limitations: The exact graph formula assumes the defining operator is invertible.
Graph rigidity in q and n is stated only within the invertible almost-abelian family.
A later projective complete-multipartite theorem overlaps the qualitative mechanism but not the element-level classification.
title: Invertible almost-abelian Lie algebras have action-blind noncommuting graphs
